name: AL Cubers Warm Up 2023
information: AL Cubers Warm Up 2023 is being held in the same venue the morning of [CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSASoutheastFMCChampio2023), which is a multi-location FMC Championship. We recommend checking it out and registering for it as well if you are interested. **Please be aware of all registration and competitor requirements before registering!**
